topic: should I start an SGLT2 inhibitor for my patient with HFrEF?
rejected: DAPA-HF (PMID 31535829) and the 2022 AHA/ACC/HFSA guideline full text are not openly in PMC. The stored guideline abstract does not state an SGLT2 recommendation.

source.title: SGLT2 inhibitors decrease cardiovascular death and heart failure hospitalizations in patients with heart failure: A systematic review and meta-analysis
source.whyItFits: Meta-analysis of randomised SGLT2-inhibitor trials in heart failure, with a reduced-ejection-fraction subgroup for the composite of cardiovascular death or worsening heart failure.
